description: Posts of public Facebook pages, or single posts by URL: text, time, likes, comments, shares, reactions by type, video views, media, links and optional video transcript. 5 points per returned record.

max_items.description: Max posts from a page (up to 1000) Default: 20.

newer_than.description: Posts newer than (date or period). e.g. 2024-01-01 or 3 months

older_than.description: Posts older than (date or period). e.g. 2024-12-31 or 1 week

url.description: Page URL, page name or post URL. e.g. https://www.facebook.com/humansofnewyork/

name: run_facebook_posts
title: Facebook posts
